# OpsFloA

> OpsFloA is a customizable, browser-based operations platform for mobile and
> office teams. It brings time clock, scheduling, work records, field updates,
> inventory, approvals, reporting, and payroll preparation into one system.
> Companies can turn modules on or off, customize labels, and keep the daily
> app simple while preserving deeper controls for admins.

Website: https://www.opsfloa.com/

## What OpsFloA does

OpsFloA helps small and mid-sized companies coordinate the daily work that often
gets scattered across texts, paper, spreadsheets, photos, disconnected apps, and
memory. It is built for teams that move between offices, shops, warehouses,
customers, routes, field locations, job sites, or service work.

The product is not limited to one trade or industry. It is useful for companies
that need a simple day-to-day app for workers and a deeper operating record for
managers, administrators, payroll prep, inventory control, reporting, and
customer-facing requests.

## Core capabilities

- **Time clock and scheduling** - mobile clock-in/out, live status, schedules,
  time off requests, approvals, overtime rules, pay-period locks, and reports.
- **Work records** - daily notes, photos, tasks, punchlists, inspections,
  checklists, service records, incidents, customer history, and project history.
- **Inventory and resources** - items, stock, locations, areas, racks, bays,
  bins, compartments, counts, transfers, valuation, purchase activity, and
  documents tied to work.
- **Projects, clients, and public requests** - organize work by project, client,
  customer, route, service area, or whichever labels the company uses. Public
  request intake and public company profiles can be enabled when useful.
- **Approvals and reporting** - admin review, operational reports, analytics,
  exports, payroll preparation, budget visibility, and exception tracking.
- **QuickBooks Online sync** - optional add-on for syncing approved activity and
  related records to QuickBooks Online.
- **Certified payroll and prevailing wage** - optional add-on for companies that
  need classifications, fringe benefits, SSN last-4 handling, signatures, and
  WH-347-style reporting.
- **Customization** - role permissions, module visibility, company labels, and
  setup questions help each company keep unnecessary tools out of the way.
- **PWA/mobile access** - no app-store rollout required. OpsFloA runs in the
  browser and can be installed to a phone home screen as a PWA.
- **Offline-friendly workflows** - time and work submissions can queue locally
  and sync when the connection returns.

## Who OpsFloA is for

OpsFloA is intended for small and mid-sized businesses with operational teams
that need better coordination between the people doing the work and the people
closing the day in the office.

Examples include service businesses, field teams, route teams, facilities teams,
shops, warehouses, maintenance groups, contractors, specialty trades, project
teams, and companies that need time, work records, inventory, and approvals in
one practical system.

## Pricing

- **Free** - $0/month, up to 3 team members, time clock, scheduling, and recent
  history.
- **Starter** - $20/month, up to 10 team members, geofencing, exports, mileage,
  and pay-period controls.
- **Business** - $35/month, 15 team members included, reports, work tracking,
  customers, checklists, analytics, and deeper operational controls.

Additional team members and add-ons may have separate pricing. Annual billing
may include a discount.

## What OpsFloA is not

- OpsFloA is not a full payroll processor. It prepares, reviews, exports, and
  syncs payroll-related time data, but paycheck issuance and tax withholding
  remain with a payroll system or accounting platform.
- OpsFloA is not a full ERP or accounting ledger.
- OpsFloA is not meant to force every company into one workflow. It is designed
  to be configured so simple daily actions stay visible and specialized tools
  stay available when needed.

## Common questions

**Does OpsFloA work in a browser?** Yes. OpsFloA is browser-based and can be
installed to a phone home screen as a PWA.

**Does the team need to download an app?** No app-store download is required.

**Can different companies show different tools?** Yes. Modules, role
permissions, and company labels let each company tailor the app.

**Does it work offline?** Time and work submissions can queue locally and sync
when the connection returns.

**Can OpsFloA help with payroll prep?** Yes. OpsFloA supports time approvals,
overtime rules, pay-period controls, reports, exports, and optional QuickBooks
Online sync.

**Can OpsFloA support certified payroll?** Yes, as an optional add-on for
companies that need prevailing wage and certified payroll workflows.
